part: Puya PY25Q128HA-DFH-IR (USON8 3x3x0.55, package code DF), U13 blackbox NOR (D66)
datasheet: Puya PY25Q128HA datasheet Rev 2.0 (2024-05-07) [p2v3/flash_work/dl/puya_E53971/ds.pdf; https://atta.szlcsc.com/upload/public/pdf/source/20250117/E5397163A091235CFF3CDB19865BC1CE.pdf]: p106 13.7 8-Pad USON(3x3x0.55mm), drawing QRPD-0077 rev 1.0: D 2.90/3.00/3.10, E 2.90/3.00/3.10, A 0.50/0.55/0.60, b 0.25/0.30/0.35, L 0.50/0.60/0.70 (leads run from the body edge, no pull-back), e 0.80 BSC, Ne 2.40 BSC, two exposed tie-bar tabs E2 0.70/0.80/0.90 x D2 0.10/0.20/0.30 on the body centre line between the lead columns, inner gap K 0.70/0.80/0.90 (pin-1-side tab chamfered); pins p4 Fig 3-2 / Table 3-1 (1 CS#, 2 SO, 3 WP#, 4 GND, 5 SI, 6 SCLK, 7 HOLD#/RESET#, 8 VCC; counter-clockwise from the top view); package code DF p97, valid part number PY25Q128HA-DFH-IR p98. The data sheet gives NO land pattern and no statement on the tabs' electrical role Verified official Puya v2.3 (2025-05-28), p4 Table3-1 and p105 QRPD-0077: eight electrical terminals only; centre tabs unnumbered. Internal tab continuity is unspecified and no inter-tab route is required.
derivation: IPC-7351 least density (L) variant of lib:USON-8_3x3mm_P0.8mm_EP_PY25Q128HA (D109, D101 full land set): toe 1.58 (D 2.90/3.00/3.10 -> 1.55 max + 0.03), heel 0.81 kept (>= D/2-Lmax 0.80), width 0.29 kept (IPC L 0.285), tab lands unchanged. Rule: outer land edge = max(terminal end nominal + 0.05, terminal end at max package tolerance + 0.03), capped at nominal + 0.15; heel kept unless it ran past D/2 - Lmax; side = max(IPC-7351B L X, b nominal), never wider than the original; courtyard = max(body, lands) + 0.10. Origin, pad numbers, EP/paste/mask and 3D model unchanged. Base derivation: Frame: data-sheet top view (pins 1-4 along one edge) turned 90 deg so pins 1-4 run down the left side, pin 1 top-left (KiCad +y down); lead span along x. IPC-7351B least density for no-lead SON (Jt 0.20, Jh 0, Js -0.04, F 0.05, P 0.025, RMS tolerances; flash_work/ipc.py): Zmax 3.508, Gmin 1.622, Xmax 0.285 -> lands 0.94 x 0.29 centred at x +-1.28 (x 0.81..1.75: heel at Gmin/2, toe 0.25 past the body edge), rounded to 0.01; least density = the house GD25Q32E toe rule (density, D33/D34). Tabs: lands 1:1 with the nominal tab (0.20 x 0.80 at x 0, y +-0.80; K 0.80 gap), two unnumbered floating mechanical lands; no electrical/common-pad assignment is documented in Puya v2.3 p4 Table3-1 or p105 QRPD-0077; 1:1 paste on every land. Courtyard = max(body, lands) + 0.10 by normalise_courtyard.py
